Chapter 6490: Outnumbered

Chapter 6490: Outnumbered

The second made the sky turn dark, extinguishing the dao. The duo’s expression darkened since blocking the first took everything they had.

“Watch it!” North Kun God took one step and crossed through dimensions to save them, abandoning his current battlefield.

He exerted his speed to the limit and made it to the other side of the dream realm.

“Go!” The return path rushed toward the giant.

“All shall return to the origin.” He murmured.

The path received the incoming power and directed destructive shockwaves to a single point, causing them to shatter from their momentum.

Since the return path encompassed all the dream realms. Sea of Heavenly Sin quaked violently. Everyone in the dreams felt as if they had been hit. Weaker cultivators vomited blood.

“Paragon is boundless!” The ancestor of gods didn’t give up and shot out a divine inferno. It looked just as big as North Kun’s return path.

“One Paragon!” The being shouted, condensing the inferno into a single colossal blade.

It tore the sky, revealing the real world beyond. The smaller dreams’ fabrics broke down, causing many to be sent back.

This move was potent enough to either slice the dream world into two halves or destroy it entirely.

“Immortal Guard.” North Kun spewed out true energy and activated his most profound dao, opening a door with a supreme power within.

As this power blessed him, immortal strands appeared behind him. They twisted together to form an immortal rune capable of suppressing everything in the mortal world. This was not an image but the real thing left behind by an immortal.

He used his supreme power to borrow the power of the rune, successfully stopping the blade.

“Is he a supreme overlord now?!” His opponents couldn’t believe it.

“Not yet, but he’s infinitely close. He might be the first...” One of them said softly and became jealous.

North Kun was only one step away from becoming a supreme overlord, able to harness the supreme power beyond. It wouldn’t take long before the final step.

Seventy-two Origin Ancestor and the others had a long way to go, hence their jealousy.

“So strong.” The woman couldn’t help but praise.

“Unfortunately, you are outnumbered, Fellow Daoist. You will not leave this place.” She said.

“Go.” She ordered Seventy-two’s group.

The power of life initiated and startled North Kun. Just dealing with this ancestral being created from Paragon was difficult enough, let alone Paramount as well.
